text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while watching Chrono Genesis's 
training—
choice_data_list:
Yeah, you've definitely gotten more 
supple!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
It's rare for me to be praised like 
that...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She used to overthink, which made her 
running stiff. Now, though, she's properly 
relaxed and...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...So by that, you mean... not so much 
about the muscles and joints, but rather 
the attitude towards running...?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I see... In other words, "the stiffness is 
starting to leave my running"... is that 
it?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly♪ I totally get what you're 
trying to say, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, great work♪ It kinda makes me 
remember back when I first enrolled here.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You know, when Curren was a freshman, my 
running was a little stiff, too. But I 
improved from there.
choice_data_list:
You know, you two might actually have 
similar paths to improving.

Indeed, your paths to improvement might be 
quite similar.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, really? Maybe we're on the same 
wavelength. As expected of Chrono-chan's 
Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I suggested to Chrono Genesis that this 
was a good opportunity to study Curren 
Chan's running style too. That way, she 
could...!
choice_data_list: I know you can get even stronger!
I know I can get even stronger!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I see... That is a fine idea. No matter 
how much history one unravels, analyzing 
one's own growth curve is always a 
difficult task.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. To think you'd come 
up with a method like this...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
You really pay close attention to my 
running, don't you?
